title: Church Tax in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Berlin charges 9 per cent of your income tax**, not of your salary, and caps it at **3 per cent of taxable income** automatically. On taxable income of €40,000 that is about **€649 a year**; at €60,000 about **€1,281**.
**The fastest check is your payslip.** Find the line marked **Kirchensteuer** or **KiSt** and multiply by twelve. If there is no such line, you are not paying it.

**You cannot leave online.** The declaration is signed in person at the Amtsgericht for your registered address, or written out and notarised. The court fee is **€30**, and the Berlin police warn about sites that offer to do it for you.

**Your court is not your Bezirk.** Ten courts follow the pre-2001 district map: Prenzlauer Berg goes to Mitte, Wedding and Gesundbrunnen to Wedding, Tempelhof and Mariendorf to Kreuzberg, Marzahn-Hellersdorf to Lichtenberg.
**The month decides the money.** The exemption starts at the end of the month your declaration reaches the court, so the month you sign is the last month you pay.

**Check before you book if you work for a church employer.** Caritas, Diakonie, church kindergartens and hospitals treat leaving as a loyalty question, although a March 2026 European Court of Justice ruling limits dismissal on that ground alone.
